consequence.statement: New optional metrics are available for monitoring certificate lifecycles; existing deployments are unaffected.

assertion.statement: Two new Prometheus metrics for certificate issuance and expiration times are now available: certmanager_certificate_not_before_timestamp_seconds and certmanager_certificate_not_after_timestamp_seconds.
